thread:
sam: Heads-up — planning to enable meridian-7b-v1 in the catalog during the 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC change window. Start canary at 10%, then 25% after 30m if stable. Need ops + release signoff.

maya: @sam +1 on the window. Are we pinning the EU region to the quant variant or global default?

oleg: meridian-7b-v1 uses smaller mem config; runtime tests passed but we need explicit fallback mapping to quantv2 for EU because some hosts lack fp16.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: meridian-7b-v1 enable -> canary 10% at 2026-04-02T02:00Z. Runbook: <https://handbook/release/meridian>.

carla: Please add a TTL on fallback so traffic doesn't oscillate. Suggest fallback_ttl=300s, retry_backoff=60s.

sam: Agreed. Adding canary pin name meridian-7b-v1-pin-0426. Rollback criteria: P95 latency > 1200ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained 5m.

maya: Add an automated eval check too — if hallucination score on the canary eval set rises > 2% absolute, trigger alert.

oleg: Ownership note: eng-releases will cut traffic, eng-runtime responsible for hotfixes/compat, infra will handle capacity/evictions. If we hit rollback, follow the deploy runbook and notify customers.

sam: @felix can you be on standby for the cut window?

felix: Yep. I'll watch infra dashboards (heap, GPU mem, pod churn) and stand by to evict noisy nodes.

sam: Commands we'll run for the canary pin:
```bash
# pin meridian to canary bucket at 10%
deployctl catalog pin --model meridian-7b-v1 --bucket canary --percent 10
```

sam: And to cut back to 0% (rollback):
```bash
deployctl catalog pin --model meridian-7b-v1 --bucket canary --percent 0
```

carla: I'll add the TTL and backoff to the runtime config in the runbook and link the alert dashboards.

maya: Post-release notes checklist: list fallbacks (comet-13b -> nebula-7b-quant), rollback criteria, runbook links, and customer-facing note draft.

carla: Updated runbook: <https://handbook/release/meridian/runbook> — includes fallback chain and metrics to watch.

deploy-bot: deploy started: enable initiated at 2026-04-02T02:00Z, canary bucket: 10%. Monitoring hooks activated.

sam: Thanks all. We'll hold here for 45m after canary to verify telemetry. If things look good we'll bump to 25%. If not: cut to 0% and open postmortem. :thumbsup:
